docs.text: Data Analytics Welcome! I'm Aayush, your Facilitator for this training programme. This course is designed specifically for Professionals who want to harness the power of Data Analytics to automate, analyse, and visualise financial data — with zero prior coding experience required. What You Will Learn Module Topic Key Skills 01 Tableau Basics Variables, data types, loops, functions, tax calculator Who Is This For? CA graduates and finance professionals Absolute beginners — no coding background needed Anyone looking to automate repetitive financial tasks How to Use This Course !!! tip "Getting Started" Work through the modules in order — each one builds on the previous. Every module includes: - Clear explanations with finance-focused examples - Runnable code cells you can experiment with - Mini exercises after each section - Full solutions at the end !!! note "Tools Required" - Python 3.8 or above - Jupyter Notebook or JupyterLab - Libraries: numpy , pandas , matplotlib , seaborn Install everything at once: ```bash pip install numpy pandas matplotlib seaborn jupyterlab ``` Connect With Me I'd love to stay connected beyond this session — whether you have questions, want to discuss ideas, or just expand your professional network. 🔗 Connect on LinkedIn Python for CA Professionals — ICAN Training Programme
